children: *Goodwin In Talks to Sell Substantial Part of Mechanical Engineering Division to Cerberus
*Goodwin: Potential Sale Would Be for Up to GBP1.1B in Cash
Goodwin in Talks to Sell Portion of Mechanical Engineering Arm for Up to $1.49 Billion
Goodwin said it is in advanced talks to potentially sell a substantial part of its mechanical engineering division for up to 1.1 billion pounds ($1.49 billion) in cash.
The engineering group said it is mulling a sale of a substantial part of the division to funds advised by Cerberus Capital Management.
The division includes Goodwin Steel Castings, Goodwin International, Noreva, Easat Group and Pumps.
Goodwin said that Cerberus Capital Management is an investor with significant relevant industry experience. There is no certainty of a transaction, Goodwin added.
